source_excerpt: Information collected from customers for the purpose of opening of account shall be treated as confidential and details thereof shall not be divulged for the purpose of cross selling, or for any other purpose without the express permission of the customer.

question: Which of the following is not listed among the exceptions to the secrecy rule in paragraph 55(d)?
options: where disclosure is under compulsion of law
where there is a duty to the public to disclose
where the interest of RE requires disclosure
where the customer has defaulted on a loan
source: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016, DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 (Updated as on August 14, 2025), paragraph 55(d)
source_excerpt: The exceptions to the said rule shall be as under: i. Where disclosure is under compulsion of law, ii. Where there is a duty to the public to disclose, iii. Where the interest of RE requires disclosure, and iv. Where the disclosure is made with the express or implied consent of the customer.

question: Within how many days of commencement of an account-based relationship must REs upload the customer's KYC records onto the CKYCR, under paragraph 56(b)?
options: within three days
within seven days
within thirty days
within 10 days
source: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016, DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 (Updated as on August 14, 2025), paragraph 56(b)
source_excerpt: In terms of provision of Rule 9(1A) of the PML Rules, the REs shall capture customer’s KYC records and upload onto CKYCR within 10 days of commencement of an account-based relationship with the customer.

question: Which organisation has the Government of India authorised to act as, and perform the functions of, the Central KYC Records Registry?
options: the Reserve Bank of India, which is otherwise the regulator of the REs under this Master Direction
the Securities and Exchange Board of India for securities market intermediaries
the Central Registry of Securitisation Asset Reconstruction and Security Interest of India
the Unique Identification Authority of India, which issues Aadhaar numbers
source: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016, DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 (Updated as on August 14, 2025), paragraph 56(a)
source_excerpt: Government of India has authorised the Central Registry of Securitisation Asset Reconstruction and Security Interest of India (CERSAI), to act as, and to perform the functions of the CKYCR vide Gazette Notification No. S.O. 3183(E) dated November 26, 2015.

question: Under paragraph 57(b), using whose digital signature must the online FATCA/CRS reports be submitted?
options: the statutory auditor of the RE
the Principal Officer of the RE
the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the RE
the Designated Director
source: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016, DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 (Updated as on August 14, 2025), paragraph 57(b)
source_excerpt: Submit online reports by using the digital signature of the ‘Designated Director’ by either uploading the Form 61B or ‘NIL’ report, for which, the schema prepared by Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) shall be referred to.

question: Which set of Income Tax Rules must REs adhere to under the FATCA and CRS reporting requirements described in paragraph 57?
options: Rules 114A, 114B and 114C
Rules 114B, 114C and 114D
Rules 114F, 114G and 114H
Rules 114C, 114E and 114G
source: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016, DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 (Updated as on August 14, 2025), paragraph 57
source_excerpt: Under FATCA and CRS, REs shall adhere to the provisions of Income Tax Rules 114F, 114G and 114H

question: Under paragraph 73, what is the status of the approvals and acknowledgements that were given under the circulars repealed with the issuance of these directions?
options: they lapse on the day these directions come into effect
they are deemed as given under these directions
they must be re-obtained from the Reserve Bank within six months
they remain valid only for accounts opened before the issue of these directions
source: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016, DBR.AML.BC.No.81/14.01.001/2015-16 (Updated as on August 14, 2025), paragraph 73
source_excerpt: All approvals / acknowledgements given under the above circulars shall be deemed as given under these directions.
